facts.claim: The Swiss Museum of Transport covers rail, road, water, air and space travel with interactive exhibits and an energy exhibition.
facts.sourceLocation: A paradise for inquisitive minds: development of mobility on rail, road, water, in the air and in space; interactive permanent exhibition on energy and electricity.

facts.claim: The complex has a film theatre, planetarium and Swiss Chocolate Adventure; ticket products distinguish activities.
facts.sourceLocation: Cinema; Planetarium; Swiss Chocolate Adventure; Day pass; Museum admission incl. Media World.
